definitions.explanation: An ongoing medical condition that one has had for a long time and may continue to have.

examples.japanese: {持病|じびょう}の{喘息|ぜんそく}が{悪化|あっか}した。
{持病|じびょう}があるので{定期的|ていきてき}に{病院|びょういん}に{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: I go to the hospital regularly because I have a chronic condition.

examples.japanese: {持病|じびょう}がなければ{保険|ほけん}に{入|はい}りやすい。
examples.english: It's easier to get insurance if you don't have a chronic illness.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{持|も}つ (to have) + {病|びょう} (illness) → illness one has = chronic condition

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{持病|じびょう}がある - to have a chronic condition
・{持病|じびょう}を{抱|かか}える - to be living with a chronic illness
・{持病|じびょう}が{悪化|あっか}する - for a chronic condition to worsen

COMMON CHRONIC CONDITIONS:
・{糖尿病|とうにょうびょう} - diabetes
・{高血圧|こうけつあつ} - high blood pressure
・{喘息|ぜんそく} - asthma
・{腰痛|ようつう} - chronic back pain

USAGE NOTE:
Often mentioned when filling out medical forms, insurance applications, or when explaining one's health situation.
